# Price per acre is the answer, not the question.

> Price a forestry mulching or land clearing job from acres per machine-hour instead of a flat per-acre guess: head width, advance speed, passes, terrain, fuel, carbide tooth wear, machine ownership and mobilization. Free, private, nothing leaves your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
